title: Figure 17: Artist renderings of positron-engine spacecraft at Mars
description: Two artist's renderings side by side: (a) a white cylindrical spacecraft with blue solar-panel arrays in orbit near a reddish Mars; (b) a spacecraft with a bright blue-white glowing exhaust plume against a starfield. Caption: "Figure 17. Spacecraft Using Positron Engines. (a) Solid-core system enters Mars orbit; (b) Modified Sänger photon rocket system burns for landing on Mars (courtesy Positronics Research LLC)." Surrounding text summarizes a Mars exploration architecture using positron SSRVs.
